semantic_fixtures.covers: An opponent cannot counter the controller's protected spell, but legal targeting and Arcane Denial's remaining instructions still resolve.
Chimil's uncounterable restriction also prevents its controller from countering a spell they control.
Protection uses Chimil's live controller and active abilities when the counter effect resolves.
Chimil itself is counterable as a spell.
Discover exiles the prefix through the first qualifying nonland; decline puts the hit into hand and randomizes the remaining cards at the bottom.
Accepting Discover casts the hit without paying and randomizes only the rest of the exiled prefix at the bottom.
Discover's mana-value limit constrains both published spell faces and server-accepted face choices.
Discover handles a full-library miss and an empty library without creating a cast offer.
A qualifying spell that has no legal required target is not offered and the hit returns to hand.
Discover target preflight applies the newly exiled spell face's protection against the only legal target.
Canceling a discovered spell cast restores its exact exiled incarnation and parent Discover offer before cleanup resumes.
An unrelated concession preserves the exact Discover cast transaction while its hit is reserved on the stack; payment commits and Discover cleanup and its parent tail complete.
After an unrelated concession, canceling the reserved Discover cast restores the exact exile generation, cohort, and offer so cleanup can be declined normally.
Cast observers preserve the random library order in owner-specific server zone-sync data while public move events keep reveal order; this fixture covers engine-side views, not client relay filtering.
A declined discovered commander lets its owner choose the command zone instead of hand.
A commander in the over-limit Discover prefix can be replaced into the command zone while the remaining cohort continues.
A paused Discover commander choice is republished after one or two observer returns, survives simultaneous-entry timestamp ordering, and replays in a reconnect snapshot.
When the Discover owner leaves during an observer return, stale cast and commander choices retire, the returned permanent succeeds, and the resolving parent's effect tail reaches survivors.
A Discover cast or commander choice retires after its owner leaves directly, while the already-started resolving ability continues its survivor-affecting tail.
